name: A-Raf proto-oncogene, serine/threonine kinase

function.text: ARAF encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase A-Raf. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein modification process.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Erdheim–Chester disease. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.

selection_reason: Panel membership with educational coverage; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.

function.text: ARAF encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase A-Raf. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein modification process. Functional annotations also associate the protein with protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ARAF have been reported in erdheim–Chester disease and lung adenocarcinoma.
